item.title: Building a Small Transformer That Makes Music
item.dc:creator: Khashayar Ghamati
item.description: Building a 45M-parameter text-to-music model by hand in PyTorch - EnCodec tokens, cross-attention, home-made pipeline parallelism on two GPUs, and the silent PCIe bug that nearly stopped it. With real training curves and generated audio.
